description: Escalate low stock notification tone from warning to danger.

air.contextSnippet: notify inventory_balances.low_stock when="quantity_on_hand<=reorder_level&quantity_on_hand>0" tone=warning label="Low Stock Alert"
air.patch: notify inventory_balances.low_stock when="quantity_on_hand<=reorder_level&quantity_on_hand>0" tone=danger label="Low Stock Alert"
